name: Gray-Scott Turing
recipe: Classic Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion Turing patterns: two chemicals U,V diffuse+react into spots, stripes, coral, fingerprint mazes and self-replicating mitosis blobs, perpetually growing and dividing. EMERGENT morphogenesis — the pattern is alive and never settles. Default COLORFUL: V concentration through a vivid ramp (deep teal -> cyan -> yellow -> hot pink), luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame edge-to-edge. Sweep feed/kill slowly on K.section so the regime morphs (spots->stripes->coral) over minutes.
kernel: two coarse float fields U,V in S (<=170 wide) init U=1 with a few V seed patches; each frame do several Gray-Scott update steps (5-pt laplacian, Du~0.16 Dv~0.08, feed/kill drifting on K.section), map V->LUT into pixels[] buffer, upscale. K.t nudges feed/kill so it perpetually evolves.
style: coral (default, teal->cyan->yellow->pink). Also: bone (x-ray white-on-dark), thermal (blackbody), moss (green/ochre organic), ink-maze (named mono, black fingerprint on cream).

name: Diffusion-Limited Aggregation
recipe: Diffusion-limited aggregation: random-walking particles stick on contact to a growing seed, building fractal dendrites / frost / coral / lightning-crystal branches that spread across the frame. EMERGENT fractal growth. Keep injecting walkers so the crystal perpetually thickens and new tips branch; recolor by age so growth history reads. Default COLORFUL: age-gradient (deep violet core -> cyan -> white frost tips) glowing on near-black, luminance ~0.15-0.4.
kernel: occupancy grid + accreted point list in S; each frame release many random walkers near the current radius, random-walk until adjacent to an occupied cell then freeze; draw new frozen cells with an age-colored glow into a persistent buffer. K.t gates walker count; growing frontier is the motion.
style: frost (default, violet->cyan->white age gradient). Also: copper-electro (metallic dendrite on dark), gold-leaf (gold branches, black), neon-coral (magenta/teal), graphite (named mono, pencil branches on paper).

name: Truchet Flow Tiles
recipe: Truchet tiling: a grid of tiles each randomly holding two quarter-arcs (or diagonal) that connect edge-to-edge into flowing maze-like loops and labyrinth curves spanning the whole frame. Tiles slowly re-roll and the whole field scrolls so the labyrinth perpetually rewrites itself. Default COLORFUL: multi-hue arcs (gradient by position) glowing on a dark ground, or a smith-chart look. Luminance ~0.2-0.5, edge-to-edge.
kernel: cache a seeded tile-orientation grid in S (rebuild on seed/density); each frame draw arcs/lines per tile with a slow K.t scroll offset + occasional tile re-roll (K.section), stroke hue by position + K.t drift. Thick soft strokes for weave.
style: neon-weave (default, position-gradient arcs on dark). Also: circuit (copper traces, green board), stained-glass (thick leaded curves), op-art (2-color B&W, named mono), rope-knot (braided cords).

name: Voronoi Shatter
recipe: Animated Voronoi/Worley cellular field: drifting seed points partition the plane into shifting polygonal cells — shattered glass, cracked earth, dragonfly wing, soap foam. Cells breathe and slide as seeds move on K.t so the tessellation is perpetually alive. Default COLORFUL: cells filled by a per-cell hue from an iq palette with bright crack-lines between them, OR distance-field glow. Luminance ~0.2-0.55, edge-to-edge.
kernel: coarse per-pixel buffer (<=200 wide): for each pixel find nearest 1-2 of ~24 drifting seed sites (seeds move on K.t), colour by nearest-site hue and darken near the F2-F1 cell boundary for crack-lines. Cache seed layout on seed change; sites drift continuously.
style: stained-glass (default, jewel cells + dark cracks). Also: cracked-earth (ochre/umber plates), soap-foam (iridescent thin-film), voronoi-glow (distance-field neon on black), blueprint (named mono, white cracks on blue).

name: Lyapunov Fractal
recipe: Markus-Lyapunov 'Zircon Zity' fractal: the logistic map driven by an AB-sequence of two alternating growth rates; each pixel's Lyapunov exponent (stable=dark, chaotic=bright) paints swooping organic biomorphic ridges and valleys. Slowly pan/zoom the (a,b) window and morph the AB-string on K.section so the alien architecture perpetually flows. Default COLORFUL: negative exponent -> deep teal/gold ridges, positive -> dark; luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: per-pixel buffer (<=200 wide): for each pixel (a,b), iterate x=r*x*(1-x) with r alternating a/b per the AB-string ~80 iters, accumulate sum(log|r*(1-2x)|)/N = Lyapunov exponent, map through a two-sided LUT. Cache on param change; pan the window + rotate AB-string on K.t/K.section for motion.
style: zircon (default, teal/gold ridges on dark). Also: copper (metallic), thermal (blackbody exponent), bio-membrane (green/violet organic), etched (named mono, white ridges on black).

name: Phyllotaxis Spiral
recipe: Golden-angle phyllotaxis: florets placed at 137.5-degree increments on a Fermat spiral form the sunflower/pinecone double-spiral packing; the count grows and the angle micro-detunes on K.t so the parastichy spirals visibly rotate, bloom outward and re-pack. Default COLORFUL: florets colored by radius/index through an iq palette (warm core -> cool rim), dot size tapering, luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: place N florets (N grows/breathes on K.t, <=1800) at angle=i*goldenAngle(detuned by K.t), r=c*sqrt(i); draw each as a soft disk/petal sized by radius, hue by i/N + K.section drift. Optionally sub-detune the angle to reveal spiral-arm families. No heavy shadowBlur.
style: sunflower (default, warm-core->cool-rim palette). Also: chromatophore (iridescent scales), seed-head (botanical browns/golds), neon-parastichy (spiral arms as glowing lines), ink-dot (named mono, stipple on cream).

name: Growing Maze
recipe: A perfect maze carves itself via randomized growth (recursive-backtracker / growing-tree), the frontier snaking through the grid; once complete a bright solver flood-fills the solution path, then it dissolves and a new maze grows. EMERGENT generation you can watch. Default COLORFUL: walls in a cool hue, the carving head + solution path glowing hot (amber/white), on a dark ground. Luminance ~0.18-0.45, fills frame.
kernel: grid cells + wall bitset in S; each frame advance the carver several steps (push/pop stack, knock down walls) drawing new corridors; when done run a BFS/flood colouring the solution, hold via K.section, then reset with a new seed. K.t gates carve speed; the moving frontier is the motion.
style: circuit-maze (default, cool walls + hot solver). Also: hedge (green topiary walls), blueprint (white lines on blue), dungeon (stone/torch amber), thread (named mono, single ink line on cream).

name: Cyclic CA Spirals
recipe: Cyclic cellular automaton (Greenberg-Hastings): each cell of N color-states advances to state+1 if a neighbor holds the next state, seeding from noise into spontaneous rotating spiral waves and demon-eye targets that tile the whole frame — emergent self-organizing spirals. Default COLORFUL: the N states mapped around a full hue wheel so spirals are rainbow pinwheels, luminance ~0.25-0.55, edge-to-edge.
kernel: coarse int grid state 0..N-1 in S (<=180 wide); each frame, cell -> (state+1)%N if any neighbor (radius 1-2, Moore) equals (state+1)%N, else unchanged; seed from noise, reseed a patch occasionally so spirals keep spawning; map state->hue LUT into pixels[] buffer, upscale. Use a threshold count (>=1) for crisp spirals.
style: rainbow-pinwheel (default, full hue wheel). Also: ember (red/orange states), ocean (blue/teal/green), duotone (2-band named mono-ish), phosphor (green CRT states).

name: N-Body Gravity
recipe: FIX of a weak version that collapsed to ONE bright blob in mostly-black space (dead-space fail). Re-author so 250-450 gravitating bodies stay SPREAD across the whole frame forming visible SPIRAL ARMS and multiple drifting clusters — a face-on galaxy / cluster field, not a single point. Give bodies initial ROTATIONAL velocity around the barycenter (so arms form, not collapse), soften gravity strongly + add a mild central binding so it never singularity-collapses, and periodically re-scatter. Bodies leave luminous trails. Default COLORFUL: tint by speed (cool slow -> hot fast), bright cores on deep space, luminance ~0.15-0.35 with structure across most of the frame (NOT 80% black).
kernel: body array in S (pos,vel,mass; 250-450) with softened gravity to a few heavy cores + weak mutual pull; INITIALIZE on a disk with tangential velocity ~sqrt(GM/r) so spiral arms form; integrate; draw ADD glowing dots + short trails into a fade buffer. Reset/re-scatter on K.section. Fill the frame.
style: galactic (default, blue-white cores + amber arms on space). Also: plasma (magenta/cyan), firefly (warm points), vector-trails (named mono), heat (blackbody by speed).

name: Abelian Sandpile
recipe: FIX of a weak version that rendered as random magenta/white CONFETTI instead of the iconic fractal mandala. Re-author so the ABELIAN SANDPILE structure is CRISP and GEOMETRIC: nested squares/diamonds of uniform color, sharp self-similar boundaries. The confetti was caused by noise/jitter in the render — render EXACT integer heights 0,1,2,3 via a HARD 4-color LUT (no interpolation, no random dither, no per-pixel noise). Pour many grains at the exact center each frame and run ENOUGH stabilization sweeps that the pile is fully relaxed before drawing. Default COLORFUL: the 4 heights map to a vivid ordered ramp (indigo/blue/gold/white), luminance ~0.2-0.5. The growing square frontier is the motion.
kernel: coarse integer grid in S (<=220 wide, cells hold grain count); each frame add a large batch of grains at the center cell, then run repeated full toppling sweeps (cell>=4 -> subtract 4, +1 to each of 4 neighbors) until stable (or many sweeps); render final grid heights clamped 0..3 via a hard 4-entry LUT into pixels[] buffer, upscale nearest-neighbor for crisp edges. No jitter.
style: spectral (default, indigo/blue/gold/white ordered). Also: thermal (blackbody by height), copper-oxide (patina), grayscale (named mono, 4 clean greys), neon-edge (draw only height-boundaries as glowing lines).

name: Rorschach Bloom
recipe: FIX of a weak version that was a BLURRY out-of-focus SMUDGE with no structure. Re-author as a CRISP bilaterally-symmetric INKBLOT: hard-edged organic lobes, tendrils, satellite droplets and negative-space gaps — clearly an inkblot, not a gaussian cloud. Remove heavy blur; use a THRESHOLDED fractal-noise (or reaction) field so ink has DEFINED edges, with wet-edge darkening (a thin darker rim) for the bleed. Mirror the left half exactly to the right. The blot slowly grows tendrils, holds, then a new blot morphs in (loop on K.section). Default: rich saturated ink (deep indigo or oxblood, not pure black) bleeding into off-white paper texture; high contrast; luminance ~0.35-0.6.
kernel: grow an ink MASK on the left half in S: threshold fbm(pos, K.t) above a level that breathes on K.section -> hard-edged blob; add wet-rim = darken pixels near the mask boundary; render mask*inkcolor over paper, then MIRROR x to the right when blitting. Coarse buffer upscaled. Absolutely NO full-canvas blur/filter.
style: wet-ink (default, indigo/oxblood on off-white paper). Also: classic (pure black on cream, named mono), thermal-blot (blackbody), gold-leaf (metallic ink on black), x-ray (bright blot glowing on dark).
